form.choir: three harps with a muted-trumpet singer
two sine harmoniums and muted trumpets
harps with a quiet synth duet

strategy_descriptions.song: A returning turning melody above a soft triad; its answer begins before the accompaniment finishes.
strategy_descriptions.interwoven: Two root families alternate and overlap, with contrary melodic replies and common tones carried through.
strategy_descriptions.seventh_garden: A slow seventh rests over changing triads; an upper line explores the available nearby pitches.
strategy_descriptions.two_roots: Two internal chords ask and answer, then their notes interleave in a brief conversation.
strategy_descriptions.canon: A short motif reappears a quarter note later in another register over a nearly motionless accompaniment.
strategy_descriptions.chord_melody: A foreground melodic route connects changing internal triads, with soft broken-chord replies.
strategy_descriptions.suspension: One existing pitch is held while the other chord members change underneath, then the melodic thread answers.
strategy_descriptions.quiet_trios: Two softly blended trios take turns, with an exposed line emerging between their entries.
strategy_descriptions.invention: A small ascending subject and a descending answer share unequal rhythmic shapes; the subject returns with a changed ending.
strategy_descriptions.farewell: Earlier motifs and their two root families return as quiet, widely spaced fragments.
